description: Import an own ISO from a public URL into the VPS ISO library. Returns an operation. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

osProfile.description: OS of the ISO, sets the hardware profile on mount.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

sourceUrl.description: Public http(s) URL of the .iso file.

name: import_vserver_custom_iso
title: Import Custom VPS ISO
